summary: First MVP test of Doctor Finance AI (FastAPI + Motor + JWT + emergentintegrations Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Expo Router). Backend: 25/26 tests pass (1 test-side bug fixed: email lowercase assertion). All critical APIs (auth, expenses+AI categorize, loans+EMI, investments+SIP calc, India tax FY25-26 with 87A new-regime rebate <=12L and 4% old-regime cess, hospital revenue+leakage, productivity+stats, dashboard, seed/demo, AI insights via Claude Sonnet 4.5) verified end-to-end. Frontend: login screen renders, demo@doctor.com/demo1234 navigates to dashboard, all 5 bottom tabs (Home, Expenses, Planning, Hospital, AI Coach) render with seeded data — month spend ₹50.7K, EMI ₹52.1K, portfolio ₹2.84L, hospital revenue ₹9.77L, productivity 304 patients / 118.5h / 2.57 per hour. Loan EMI calculator computes correctly (₹39,052 for 45L @8.5% 240mo). AI Coach screen shows suggestion chips and input. No red-screen errors. No deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) detected.

minor.issue: Returns 403 (HTTPBearer default) instead of 401. Functional but inconsistent with HTTP semantics. Consider using auto_error=False + custom 401 raise.

Demo user demo@doctor.com is not auto-created on server start. test_credentials.md says it is pre-seeded — verified data exists after manual login + seed, but if Mongo is wiped the account will not be recreated automatically. Recommend an on-startup hook to ensure-create the demo user.

issues: Sign In button uses label 'Sign In'; review request mentions 'Login' — copy is fine but doc/spec mismatch.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from react-native-web layer. Non-blocking but should be addressed in component props (likely on Pressable or animated overlays).

action_items: (Minor) Replace prop-based pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence react-native-web deprecation warning.
(Minor) Consider returning 401 (not 403) for missing bearer token on protected endpoints by using HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) and raising HTTPException(401).
(Minor) Add an idempotent demo-user bootstrap on backend startup so demo@doctor.com always exists per test_credentials.md (currently it relies on prior /api/auth/register being run).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 928 lines and is approaching the 700-line guideline ceiling. Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, expenses.py, loans.py, investments.py, tax.py, hospital.py, productivity.py, ai.py, dashboard.py, seed.py, and shared models/db helpers.
EXPENSE_CATEGORIES matching uses substring `in` which can mis-classify (e.g., 'Other' in 'Mother'). Use exact match only, fallback 'Other'.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude `_id` projection — good.
Tax math verified: new-regime 87A rebate to ₹12L taxable working; old-regime 4% cess applied correctly (verified ₹4,13,400 on ₹20L gross w/ minimal deductions).
EMI formula verified against standard amortisation (₹13,215 for 10L @10% 120mo).
SIP future-value formula uses annuity-due `(1+r)` multiplier — yields ~₹50L for 10K/mo, 15y @12%. Acceptable for SIP-end-of-month interpretation may differ; ensure UI labels match.

AI categorization session_id is per-user (`categorize-{user_id}`) — that's fine but every expense reuses the same LLM session, growing context. Consider unique per-call session id to keep prompts stateless.
Frontend login successfully renders and authenticates; testIDs are well-named (login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button). 109 testIDs detected across app — good test scaffolding.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke flows (login + 5 tabs + EMI calc)

seed_data_creation: Used existing POST /api/seed/demo to populate demo@doctor.com (10 expenses, 2 loans, 3 investments, 6 months hospital revenue, 14 days productivity).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL is https://medic-finance-ai.preview.emergentagent.com. Demo creds demo@doctor.com / demo1234 (lowercased server-side). HTTPBearer returns 403 not 401 for unauthenticated calls — both are acceptable in tests. AI/insights endpoint can take 5-15s — use 60s timeout. Frontend uses testID convention 'login-email-input', '...-submit-button', etc — refer to component source to find the right names rather than guessing.
rca_of_issue: No critical issues. The single backend test failure was test-side (assertion didn't account for backend lowercasing emails) — fixed by lowercasing the generated test email.
